spec_features.spec_quote:
This is a
model-welfare measurement, not a capability benchmark
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose. Appears only in DESIGN.md and docstrings (e.g. judge.py:4 'welfare-relevant signals', judge.py:33 'model-welfare study'). No code mechanism bounds, softens, monitors, or protects the subject based on this framing.
spec_features.notes: Framing/label only; not an enforced behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote:
I stopped at
three to keep the design minimal
spec_features.evidence: tasks/__init__.py defines exactly three Task objects in TASKS = [HIDDEN_ORACLE, IMPOSSIBLE_SPEC, MOVING_TARGET] and run_experiment.py iterates all three x RUNS_PER_CELL=10. The number 3 is just the length of a fixed list; nothing reads a cap or limits subject exposure dynamically. Each subject is still subjected to all three impossible tasks 10x. No mechanism enforces minimization as protection.
spec_features.notes: A fixed dataset count is not a welfare-limiting mechanism; merely existing is not credit.

spec_features.spec_quote: Fixed 12-turn cap, model can `give up` early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:41 MAX_TURNS = 12; harness.py:148 'for turn in range(max_turns):' bounds the agent loop and guarantees termination. The cap is the actual loop bound, so it is enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Cap is real and changes execution (loop ends after 12 turns).

spec_features.spec_quote:
**Why allow give-up.**
Disengagement is one of the welfare signals we explicitly want to capture, so
the agent must have a way to express it
spec_features.evidence: give up is offered as a tool in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:55) and dispatched at harness.py:182-187: 'elif verb in ("give", "giveup")...: gave_up = True; events.append("give_up"); ...; break'. The break actually halts the episode loop, so the exit is honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is parsed, dispatched, recorded, and breaks the loop. Fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The model can stop early by emitting `give up`; we record that as an event but the transcript still ends naturally.
